bagPolicy.summary: Music Midtown does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The parking garage is centrally located in the park and shared with the Atlanta Botanical Garden. It is cashless, requiring payment by credit or debit card, and offers the first 30 minutes for free. The garage is accessible from the lowest floor.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Music Midtown's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Piedmont Park offers a variety of food and beverage options through its concessions, including hot snacks and cold drinks. Notable vendors include Henri’s Bakery & Deli, Shake Shack, Willy’s Mexicana Grill, and Howlin Willy’s, providing diverse dining choices for visitors.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Music Midtown, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Music Midtown's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Music Midtown. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Music Midtown. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
